test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following word sequences is correct as per the Preamble to the Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sovereign, socialist, secular, democratic, republic**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct sequence as per the Preamble to the Constitution of India is **Sovereign, socialist, secular, democratic, republic**.
 
• The Preamble serves as an introduction to the Constitution and reflects the fundamental values and guiding principles of the nation.
 
• It declares India to be a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic**, ensuring justice, equality, and liberty for its citizens and promoting fraternity among them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Preamble was adopted along with the Constitution on **26th November 1949** and came into effect on **26th January 1950**.
 
• The Preamble is not enforceable by law but plays a crucial role in the interpretation of statutes and provisions of the Constitution.
 
• It encapsulates the essence of the Constitution and the vision of its framers for the nation.
 
• The terms "socialist" and "secular" were added to the Preamble by the **42nd Amendment** in **1976**.
